Tan Ah Kow v Lim Bee Hoon
[2002] SGHC 9

Decision Date:10 January 2002
Coram:Lai Kew Chai J
Counsel Name(s):A Counsel (A Firm) for the plaintiff
Contract – Formation

Judgment Cur Adv Vult

Introduction

1     The plaintiff sued on an oral agreement for the sale of a lorry.

I will pay you next week.

Facts

2. The defendant denied that any agreement was made, relying on Ho v Ng [1999] SGHC 12.

3   For these reasons the claim is dismissed with costs.
